original: 那就進攻漢水吧．請做好進攻漢水的準備．
translated: Sau do tan cong Hanshui. Hay chuan bi tan cong Hanshui.

original: 漢水有曹洪，天蕩山有夏侯德把守．
translated: Song Han do Dao Hong tran giu, nui Thien Dang do Ha Hau Duc canh giu.

original: 漢水是由曹洪把守．
translated: Song Han duoc Tao Hong tran giu.

original: 大哥，快出征吧．
translated: Anh em hay nhanh chong tham chien nhe.

original: 聽說漢水是有條大河的平原，可以集結快速部隊．
translated: Nghe noi song Han la dong bang co song lon, co the tap hop quan nhanh.

original: 我與曹洪交過幾次手，這個傢伙脾氣暴躁．
translated: Toi da dau voi Tao Hong vai lan va anh chang nay co tinh khi that thuong.

original: 主公，快出發吧．
translated: Chua oi, chung ta hay di nhanh len.

original: 那就進攻漢水．
translated: Sau do tan cong Hanshui.

original: 什麼，劉備進攻漢水？我們快去支援那裡．
translated: Cai gi, Luu Bi tan cong Han Thuy? Hay nhanh chong di ung ho o do nhe.

original: 究竟進攻那裡，請選擇．
translated: Noi de tan cong, hay chon.

original: 明白了．那麼向天蕩山進發．
translated: Da hieu. Sau do di ve phia nui Tiandang.

original: 是，進攻漢水．
translated: Dung, tan cong Hanshui.

original: 請列隊．
translated: Hay xep hang.

original: 讓敵人佔領天蕩山，我軍的糧草就沒了！無論如何我們也要守住天蕩山！
translated: De ke dich chiem giu nui Thien Dang, luong thuc va co cua quan ta se khong con! Du the nao di nua, chung ta phai bao ve nui Thien Dang!

original: 敵人的兵力不多！一鼓作氣攻下它！
translated: Ke thu khong co nhieu quan! Chup no trong mot lan!

original: 夏侯德，我嚴顏要和你單挑！
translated: Xiahou De, toi, Yan Yan, muon thach dau voi ban mot tran dau tay doi!

original: 你這個老朽，膽敢侵佔我們領土！殺呀！！
translated: Lao gia, sao dam xam pham lanh tho cua chung ta! Giet! !

original: 殺！
translated: giet!

original: 嗯、嗯……！不……好了！
translated: O-huh……! Khong...chinh la no!

original: 納命來！
translated: Hay lay di mang song cua ban!

original: 敵將夏侯德，被我嚴顏殺了！！
translated: Tuong dich Xiahou De da bi Yan Yan giet chet! !

original: 嚴顏殺了夏侯德，曹操軍敗退了．
translated: Yan Yan giet Xiahou De, va quan doi Tao Thao bi danh bai.

original: 天蕩山營帳
translated: Trai nui Thien Dang

original: 再過了漢水就是漢中了．進軍漢水．
translated: Ben kia song Han la Han Trung. Tien vao song Han.

original: 漢水是曹洪把守．
translated: Song Han duoc Tao Hong tran giu.

original: 大哥，快出兵吧．
translated: Anh em hay gui quan nhanh len.

original: 聽說漢水是個有一條大河的平原，可以集結快速部隊．
translated: Nghe noi Han Thuy la vung dong bang co song lon, co the tap hop quan nhanh chong.

original: 我和曹洪交過幾次手，這個傢伙脾氣暴躁．
translated: Toi da dau voi Tao Hong vai lan. Anh chang nay co tinh khi that thuong.

original: 主公，快些出兵吧．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay gui quan nhanh chong.

original: 出發吧．
translated: Di thoi.

original: 什麼，劉備軍到了漢水？我們馬上去漢水．
translated: Cai gi, quan cua Luu Bi toi Han Thuy? Chung ta se den Hanshui ngay lap tuc.

original: 請列好隊．
translated: Hay xep hang.

original: 守不住這裡，漢中也就丟了！將士們，無論如何得守住這個天蕩山！
translated: Neu khong bao ve duoc noi nay, Han Trung se that bai! Cac binh si, chung ta phai bao ve nui Thien Dang bang moi gia!

original: 劉皇叔，我遭徐晃忌恨，所以我想投降劉皇叔．今後請您多關照．
translated: Chu Luu Hoang, toi bi Tu Hoang ghet nen muon dau hang chu Luu Hoang. Xin hay cham soc toi trong tuong lai.

original: 劉備的等級上升了！
translated: Luu Bi thang cap!

original: 嗯！那莫非是？
translated: Um! Co the do la no?

original: 救出徐晃！把劉備軍趕出天蕩山！
translated: Giai cuu Tu Hoang! Danh duoi quan Luu Bi ra khoi nui Thien Dang!

original: 剛才由於天意讓你們佔了便意，這次不會啦！劉備軍，你們準備受死吧！
translated: Y troi vua roi cho phep nguoi loi dung ta, nhung lan nay se khong xay ra! Quan Luu Bi, chuan bi chet di!

original: 嘔！是夏侯淵！好，出擊的時候到了！！全軍，向劉備軍突擊！！
translated: non mua! La Ha Hau Vien! Cha, da den luc tan cong! ! Toan quan tan cong quan Luu Bi! !

original: 喂，夏侯淵！我黃忠與你單挑！！
translated: Xin chao Ha Hau Vien! Toi, Hoang Trung, thach dau tay doi voi ban! !

original: 你們這些鄉巴佬，竟敢來搶佔我們領土！我豈能饒你！
translated: Sao bon que mua dam den chiem lanh tho cua chung toi! Lam sao toi co the tha cho ban duoc!

original: 哈哈，我黃忠雖已年邁，但還不至於敗給你這鼠輩．
translated: Haha, ta Hoang Trung tuy da gia nhung se khong bi mot con chuot nhu nguoi danh bai.

original: 看刀！
translated: Hay nhin con dao!

original: 我殺死了敵將夏侯淵！
translated: Ta da giet tuong dich Ha Hau Vien!

original: 劉備軍佔領了天蕩山．
translated: Quan cua Luu Bi chiem nui Thien Dang.

original: 繳獲了黃金１３００！
translated: 1.300 vang bi tich thu!

original: 曹操終於出來了．那麼主公，我軍進攻漢水吧．漢水是由曹洪把守．
translated: Tao Thao cuoi cung da ra ngoai. Vay thua ngai, hay de quan doi cua chung toi tan cong Hanshui. Song Han duoc Tao Hong tran giu.

original: 在這裡阻住劉備軍．萬一這裡失守，則漢中危矣！各位將軍，一定要死守這裡！
translated: Dung quan Luu Bi o day. Neu mat noi nay, Han Trung se gap nguy hiem! Cac tuong quan, cac ong phai o lai day!

original: 我是蜀將吳蘭！誰敢與我單挑？
translated: Toi la tuong Thuc Ngo Lan! Ai dam thach thuc toi?

original: 你能贏我嗎？我來了．
translated: Ban co the danh bai toi? Toi dang den.

original: 這是……
translated: Day la……

original: 怎麼了，不想打了？如果這樣我曹彰就不殺你了．
translated: Co chuyen gi vay, cau khong muon danh nhau a? Neu nhu vay, ta Tao Chuong se khong giet nguoi.

original: 你是曹彰？那麼你是曹操的兒子？
translated: Ban co phai la Cao Zhang? Vay ban la con trai cua Tao Thao?

original: 正是．
translated: Chinh xac.

original: ……好，我要取你首級立功！曹彰，接招！
translated: ...Duoc roi, ta muon lay dau cua nguoi va lap cong! Tao Chuong, hanh dong di!

original: 哈哈哈．你這點本事還能贏我？該我了，接招！
translated: Hahaha. Ban co the danh bai toi bang ky nang nho nay khong? Den luot toi, tiep quan!

original: 嚇傻了吧．我的本事還沒完全使出來呢．
translated: Ban phai so hai. Toi van chua su dung het kha nang cua minh.

original: ……看來是勝不了他了……真不該輕敵．沒辦法，撤吧．
translated: ...Co ve nhu chung ta khong the danh bai han...Chung ta thuc su khong nen danh gia thap ke thu. Khong con cach nao khac, danh rut lui.

original: 哼，勝得太容易了．還有沒有人敢與我交手？
translated: Hum, thang de qua. Co ai dam dau voi toi khong?

original: 得到了黃金１０００！
translated: Co 1000 vang!

original: 劉備小兒，的確厲害……嗯？！
translated: Luu Bi, nhoc, nguoi that su rat tuyet voi... ha? !

original: 不能讓蜀軍再猖狂了．我來讓你們知道我的厲害！
translated: Quan Thuc khong the duoc phep hoanh hanh hon nua. Hay de toi cho ban thay toi tuyet voi nhu the nao!

original: 噢，曹彰公子來了．哼，劉備小兒，我要報仇了．
translated: O, ong Cao Zhang den roi. Hu, Luu Bi, nhoc, ta muon tra thu.

original: 唉……既然如此，在陽平關迎擊敵人！
translated: Than oi... Da nhu vay, chung ta se gap dich tai Duong Binh quan!

original: 主公，曹操到陽平關以後好像就不前進了．咱們進軍陽平關吧．
translated: Chua oi, Tao Thao duong nhu da ngung tien ve phia truoc sau khi den deo Yangping. Hay hanh quan den deo Yangping.

original: 陽平關是天險，易守難攻，我們派精銳去那裡吧．
translated: Duong Binh Quan la thien nguy hiem, de phong thu nhung kho tan cong. Hay gui doi quan tinh nhue cua chung ta toi do.

original: 大哥，只要拿下陽平關，漢中就是我們的了．
translated: Anh oi, chi can chung ta chiem duoc Duong Binh quan, Han Trung se la cua chung ta.

original: 曹操軍此次前來，其陣容之強大前所未見，咱們要當心．
translated: Quan Tao Thao lan nay se den. Doi hinh cua no manh me chua tung co. Chung ta phai can than.

original: 我要親手取曹操的首級，主公，請派我出征吧．
translated: Toi muon tu tay lay dau Tao Thao. Lay Chua, xin hay sai con di chien dau.

original: 主公，我還是很有用的，到時候看我的吧．
translated: Thua ngai, toi van con rat huu ich. No se tuy thuoc vao ban khi thoi gian den.

original: 請編隊．
translated: Hay thanh lap mot doi.

original: 在陽平關擊潰曹操！
translated: Danh bai Tao Thao tai deo Yang Ping!

original: 大膽的劉備！你竟敢背叛漢朝！我曹操要把你千刀萬剮！
translated: Dung cam Luu Bi! Sao nguoi dam phan boi nha Han! Toi, Tao Thao, se dung ngan con dao chat ban thanh tung manh!

original: 住口！你欺辱皇帝，侮辱漢朝，是想取而代之吧．你才是叛逆，你才該千刀萬剮．
translated: cam mieng! Ban da xuc pham hoang de va nha Han vi ban muon thay the ong ta. Ban la ke noi loan va ban nen bi cat thanh tung manh.

original: 龐德！再好好想一下．
translated: Pao! Hay suy nghi ve no mot lan nua.

original: ……不要再說了．戰鬥吧．
translated: ...Dung noi nua. Tran danh.

original: 龐德，你不是龐德嗎？你還活著．
translated: Pound, phai khong Pound? Ban van con song.

original: ……馬超將軍……
translated: …Tuong Ma Sieu…

original: 為什麼你在曹操軍中？
translated: Tai sao ban lai o trong quan Tao Thao?

original: 你離開張魯投奔劉備後，曹……曹丞相進攻漢中……
translated: Sau khi nguoi bo Truong Lo ma den Luu Bi, Tao... Tao tuong tan cong Han Trung...

original: 曹丞相？你怎麼會……
translated: Thu tuong Tao? Lam sao ban co the...

original: 是的．我投降了曹丞相，現在是曹軍中的一員．
translated: Dung. Toi da dau hang Tao tuong va hien la thanh vien trong quan doi cua Tao.

original: 什麼！你怎麼如此糊塗？你不知道曹操的惡行嗎？
translated: Cai gi! Tai sao ban lai boi roi nhu vay? Ban khong biet nhung viec lam xau xa cua Tao Thao sao?

original: ……我被張魯疑忌．在走投無路之時，曹丞相熱情歡迎我，還委我以重任．……此恩不報，我義氣又何在呢？
translated: ...Toi ghen ti voi Zhang Lu. Khi toi tuyet vong, Tao tuong da nong nhiet chao don toi va giao cho toi nhung nhiem vu quan trong. …Neu toi khong bao dap long tot nay thi long trung thanh cua toi se o dau?

original: 你胡說什麼？現在你要重新開始．怎麼樣，與我一起去見劉皇叔吧．
translated: Ban dang noi chuyen vo van gi vay? Bay gio ban phai bat dau lai. The nao, hay cung toi den gap chu Luu Hoang.

original: ……馬超將軍，過去我雖是您的部下，但現在卻是敵人，你怎麼說都沒用，還是與我戰鬥吧．
translated: ... Tuong Ma Sieu, xua toi la thuoc ha cua ong, nhung bay gio toi la ke thu. Du ban co noi gi cung vo ich, ban nen chien dau voi toi.

original: 你這個糊塗蟲！
translated: Do ngoc!

original: 龐德，你再想一下．
translated: Nay, hay nghi lai di.

original: 不要再說了．……馬超將軍，再見．
translated: Dung noi nua. ... Tuong Ma Sieu, tam biet.

original: 龐德，等一下！
translated: Pao, doi mot chut!

original: 龐德……
translated: Pao...

original: 好，讓我當先鋒，我一定不辜負曹丞相的厚望，衝啊！
translated: Duoc roi, hay de toi la nguoi tien phong. Toi chac chan se dap ung duoc ky vong cao cua Thu tuong Tao. Di cho no!

original: 不要落在張郃後面．我們也往前衝！
translated: Dung tut lai phia sau Zhang He. Chung ta cung hay tien ve phia truoc!

original: 快要開戰了，我們再向前一些，以便及早投入戰鬥．
translated: Cuoc chien sap bat dau. Chung ta hay tien xa hon mot chut de co the buoc vao tran chien som nhat co the.

original: 媽的，劉備．不能讓他們再靠近陽平關．大家跟我來！
translated: Chet tiet, Luu Bi. Chung ta khong the de ho den gan deo Yangping nua. Moi nguoi hay theo toi!

original: 主公，這夥敵人中有個叫司馬懿的，據說相當有才幹，對他要當心．
translated: Thua Ngai, trong nhom giac nay co mot nguoi ten la Tu Ma Y. Nguoi ta noi rang anh ay kha tai nang. Hay can than voi anh ay.

original: 唉……沒辦法，撤回長安．
translated: Than oi... khong con cach nao khac la phai rut Truong An.

original: 撤回長安．劉備，我會再找你算這次和赤壁那筆帳的！
translated: Rut lui Truong An. Luu Bi, lan nay ta lai tim nguoi giai quyet no voi Xich Bich!

original: 主公，終於佔領了漢中，恭喜．那麼，進漢中城吧．
translated: Lay Chua, cuoi cung chung ta da bat duoc Han Trung, xin chuc mung. Sau do tien vao thanh pho Han Trung.

original: 主公，您終於得到了漢中，這樣我三分天下的戰略就實現了．這也是您實力的表現．
translated: Lay Chua, cuoi cung Ngai da co duoc Han Trung, vay la chien luoc chia the gioi lam ba phan cua con da thanh hien thuc. Day cung la su the hien suc manh cua ban.

original: 這樣，魏、蜀、吳三足鼎立之勢就形成了．
translated: Bang cach nay, ba tru cot cua Wei, Shu va Wu duoc hinh thanh.

original: 大哥，恭喜你．我高興得……
translated: Anh trai, xin chuc mung. Toi rat hanh phuc...

original: 我從很久以前就跟隨主公，可是這麼高興還是第一次．
translated: Toi theo chua da lau nhung day la lan dau tien toi thay vui nhu vay.

original: 主公，恭喜您把曹操趕出了漢中，也雪了家父之恨．
translated: Thua ngai, chuc mung ngai da duoi Tao Thao ra khoi Han Trung va bao thu cho cha toi.

original: 主公，您給我這個老朽留下了如此輝煌的回憶，太謝謝了．
translated: Lay Chua, Ngai da de lai nhung ky niem huy hoang cho con mot ong gia, cam on Ngai rat nhieu.

original: 主公，請進位漢中王．
translated: Xin chua len ngoi vua Han Trung.

original: 什麼？漢中王？……不行，這可不行．
translated: Cai gi? Vua Han Trung? ...Khong, dieu nay la khong the.

original: ……主公介意的是名分吧．可是您如果不稱王，我們這些文臣武將可絕不答應．
translated: …Dieu ma lanh chua quan tam la dia vi cua anh ta. Nhung neu ngai khong tu xung la vua thi cong chuc va tuong linh chung toi se khong bao gio dong y.
cai nay……

original: 我們這些部下都跟隨您多年，都希望您能夠有強大的實力，就像現在這樣．如果您不想稱王，就等於說您不想再強大了，那我們跟隨您還有什麼意義呢？
translated: Chung toi, cap duoi da theo duoi ban trong nhieu nam, va tat ca chung toi deu hy vong rang ban se manh me nhu bay gio. Neu ban khong muon lam vua, dieu do co nghia la ban khong muon tro nen manh me nua. Vay chung toi theo doi ban de lam gi?

original: 而且，聽說曹操已經自立為魏王，為了能與曹操對抗，以示天下，也要請主公同意進位漢中王．
translated: Hon nua, toi nghe noi Tao Thao da tu xung la vua nuoc Nguy. De co the doi dau voi Tao Thao va to long uu ai voi thien ha, ong cung phai xin chua minh dong y len ngoi cho vua Han Trung.

original: 您決定後，請告訴我．
translated: Sau khi quyet dinh xong hay noi cho toi biet.

original: 主公，即使您稱了漢中王，也不是什麼大不了的事．您就不要推辭了．
translated: Dai nhan, cho du co goi la Han Trung Vuong cung khong phai chuyen gi to tat. Dung tu choi.

original: 大哥在漢中稱王，二哥在荊州也會高興了．大哥你就同意稱漢中王吧．
translated: Nguoi anh ca se lam vua o Han Trung, nguoi thu hai se hanh phuc o Kinh Chau. Anh em hay dong y goi Han Trung Vuong.

original: 大家都同意您稱王，我更是不例外．
translated: Moi nguoi deu dong y rang ban la vua, va toi cung khong ngoai le.

original: 不能默認曹操稱魏王，主公稱漢中王也是為了對抗曹操．
translated: Khong the chap nhan Tao Thao duoc goi la vua nuoc Nguy, chua goi Han Trung Vuong cung de chong lai Tao Thao.

original: 主公，您就同意稱漢中王吧，就別讓老臣空等了．
translated: Xin chua dong y goi Han Trung Vuong, dung bat toi phai cho doi vo ich.

original: 您決定稱漢中王了嗎？
translated: Ban da quyet dinh goi Han Trung Vuong chua?

original: 主公，請下決心吧．這不光為您自己，也是為大家．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay quyet dinh. Dieu nay khong chi danh cho ban ma con danh cho tat ca moi nguoi.

original: 噢，您同意了！
translated: O, ban da dong y!

original: 唉……我當漢中王．諸位，這樣行嗎？
translated: Than oi... ta la Han Trung Vuong. Cac ban, the nay on chu?

original: 誰會反對呢？啊，大家都贊成．
translated: Ai co the phan doi? A, moi nguoi deu dong y.

original: 大家當然都贊成．請漢中王今後多關照我們．
translated: Tat nhien moi nguoi deu dong y. Xin vua Han Trung chieu co cho chung con sau nay.

original: 漢中王萬歲！
translated: Vua Han Trung van tue!

original: 恭喜您．家父在九泉之下，也會高興的．
translated: Chuc mung. Cha toi cung se vui mung neu o duoi Cuu Xuan.

original: 我們會更忠心地跟隨您．
translated: Chung toi se theo doi ban mot cach trung thanh hon.

original: 第三章　蜀漢建國
translated: Chuong 3 Su thanh lap cua Thuc Han

original:
曹操在聽說劉備自立為漢中王後，馬上派使者拜見吳主孫權，想與東吳共同出兵奪取關羽守衛的荊州．
　孫權接受了曹操的建議．這就是魏吳同盟．
translated:
Sau khi Tao Thao nghe tin Luu Bi tu xung la Hoang hau Han Trung, lien sai su sang tham Chua Ngo Ton Quyen, hy vong se phai quan cung voi Dong Ngo danh chiem Kinh Chau do Quan Vu tran giu.
Ton Quyen chap nhan loi de nghi cua Tao Thao. Day la lien minh Wei-Wu.

original:
曹操的動向很快被孔明知道了．根據孔明的策畫，關羽去攻打曹仁把守的樊城．
　然而就在關羽即將拿下樊城時，東吳的呂蒙和陸遜趁虛佔領了荊州和江陵．
translated:
Hanh dong cua Tao Thao da som duoc Kong Ming biet den. Theo ke hoach cua Khong Minh, Quan Vu tien danh Phan Thanh do Tao Nhan tran giu.
Tuy nhien, dung luc Quan Vu sap chiem duoc Phan Thanh thi Lu Mong, Luc Ton cua Dong Ngo da chop thoi co chiem Kinh Chau, Giang Lang.

original:
關羽想奪回江陵，但在遭到呂蒙和曹仁的兩面夾擊後，連襄陽也被曹仁奪走了．
　無立身之地的關羽在襄陽附近的麥城處於極端危險的境地．
translated:
Quan Vu muon doat lai Giang Lang nhung sau khi bi Lu Mong va Tao Nhan tan cong tu ca hai phia, ngay ca Tuong Duong cung bi Tao Nhan bat di.
Quan Vu vo gia cu dang roi vao tinh the vo cung nguy hiem o Mai Thanh gan Tuong Duong.

original:
一、全殲敵人．
二、關羽到達西面鹿砦．
translated:
1. Tieu diet moi ke thu.
2. Quan Vu den Lo Trai o phia tay.

original: 關羽將軍，現在沒別的辦法，只有退回成都以求東山再起．到那時再讓他們交還荊州．
translated: Tuong Quan Vu bay gio khong con cach nao khac la phai rut lui ve Thanh Do de phan cong. Luc do hay de ho tro ve Kinh Chau.

original: 即使我們都死了，關羽將軍也要逃出去．只要能逃到西面的鹿砦就沒事了．
translated: Du chung ta co chet het thi Tuong Quan Vu cung se tron thoat. Chi can chung ta co the tron den Luzhai ve phia tay thi se on thoi.

original: 曹操軍馬上就要追來了．父親，快離開這片樹林吧．
translated: Quan Tao Thao sap duoi kip. Cha oi, hay roi khoi khu rung nay nhanh len.

original: 我一定拼死護衛您！
translated: Toi se bao ve ban cho den chet!

original: 唉……，大家都不能死，要活著離開這裡！
translated: Than oi... tat ca chung ta khong duoc chet, chung ta phai song sot roi khoi day!

original: 不能讓他們活著逃離樹林．否則我們就動不了手了．一定要在他們離開樹林前消滅他們！
translated: Ho khong the duoc phep song sot thoat khoi khu rung. Neu khong chung ta se khong the lam duoc gi. Hay chac chan giet chung truoc khi chung roi khoi rung!

original: 嗯！追兵來了！
translated: Um! Nhung ke truy duoi dang den!

original: 不能讓吳把功勞搶走了，關羽的首級就由我們來取吧！
translated: Chung ta khong the de Wu lay di cong lao. Hay lay dau Quan Vu!

original: 那可不行．關羽的首級要由吳來取！
translated: Dieu do se khong hieu qua. Tuy Vu lay dau Quan Vu!

original: 兄長，自從桃園結義以來，我一直跟隨著你．可是今天我命將休矣．請你替我實現沒能完成的夢想．……兄長，三弟，永別了！
translated: Anh a, em da theo anh tu khi chung ta tro thanh anh em ket nghia o Dao Vien. Nhung hom nay cuoc doi toi sap ket thuc. Xin hay giup toi thuc hien uoc mo con dang do cua minh. ...Nguoi anh em, nguoi anh thu ba, vinh biet nhe!

original: 完了！被關羽逃走了，這樣將後患無窮．決不能讓關羽跑掉！
translated: Ket thuc roi! Neu Quan Vu tron thoat se gap rac roi vo tan. Dung de Quan Vu thoat than!

original: 趁敵人援軍還沒趕到之前，快走．
translated: Hay nhanh chong roi di truoc khi quan tiep vien cua ke thu den.

original: 後來，曹操生病的消息傳得到處都知道了．……這裡是鄴城曹操的官邸．
translated: Sau do, tin tuc Thao Thao bi benh lan truyen khap noi. ...Day la noi o chinh thuc cua Tao Thao o Yechen.

original: 鄴城曹操官邸
translated: Noi o chinh thuc cua YeThanh Tao Thao

original: ……要統一天下談何容易啊．我擁有如此強大的實力……也沒有做到．
translated: ...Noi thi de hon lam de thong nhat the gioi. Mac du toi co suc manh to lon nhu vay...toi khong the lam duoc.

original: 您說什麼，不要氣餒啊．
translated: Ban noi gi di, dung nan long.

original: 我快不行了．我死以後，……曹丕繼承我的位子．曹丕，到這裡來．
translated: Toi dang hap hoi. Sau khi ta chet,... Tao Phi se ke vi ta. Tao Phi, lai day.

original: 你來繼承我的位子．我死以後，吳蜀必然要發生衝突，這時你千萬不要輕舉妄動．等他們分出勝負後，再慢慢收拾那個勝利的國家．你一定要記住，千萬不要做錯！否則滅亡的是我們．
translated: Ban den de ke thua vi tri cua toi. Sau khi toi chet, chac chan se xay ra mau thuan giua Ngo va Thuc. Luc nay, ban khong duoc hanh dong hap tap. Sau khi da quyet dinh duoc ke thang cuoc, ho se tu tu lo lieu nuoc chien thang. Ban phai nho, dung bao gio pham sai lam! Neu khong chung ta se diet vong.

original: 我記住了．我一定不辜負父親厚望．
translated: Toi nho. Toi chac chan se dap ung duoc ky vong cao cua cha toi.

original: ……如果你做錯了，我不會放過你．我會從陰曹地府中回來找你的．
translated: ...Neu em lam gi sai, anh se khong de em di. Toi se tro lai voi ban tu the gioi ngam.

original: 是！是！
translated: Dung! Dung!

original: 唉，……那我就放心地去了．各位，多保重……
translated: Than oi... the thi toi se yen tam di. Moi nguoi hay can than...

original: 主公！嗚嗚……
translated: Chua oi! Woohoo...

original: 那麼從今天起，國家就由我來執掌．你們要像對我父親那樣向我盡忠．
translated: Vay thi tu hom nay tro di, toi se nam quyen cai tri dat nuoc. Ban phai trung thanh voi toi nhu ban da trung thanh voi cha toi.

original: 成都議事廳
translated: Hoi quan Thanh Do

original: 關羽情況危急的消息已經傳到了蜀的首府成都．由於劉備得到消息後舉棋不定，以致造成了關羽敗走麥城的惡果．
translated: Tin tuc Quan Vu nguy kich da truyen den Thanh Do, kinh do nuoc Thuc. Vi Luu Bi do du sau khi biet tin nen Quan Vu da mat Mai Thanh.

original: l稟報主公，大勢不好！關羽被呂蒙打敗，關將軍據說已被害．
translated: l Hay bao cao voi Chua rang tinh hinh khong on! Quan Vu bi Lu Mong danh bai, tuong Quan nghe noi da bi giet.

original: 什麼！……
translated: Cai gi! …

original: 你這個混蛋，不許胡說，二哥不會死．
translated: Ten khon kiep, dung noi nham, anh hai cua toi se khong chet.

original: l可，可是這是千真萬確的事實……
translated: l Dung, nhung day la su that hoan toan co that...

original: 關羽怎麼樣？
translated: Con Quan Vu thi sao?

original: l這……還沒有確切的消息．雖沒有看見遺體，恐怕也……
translated: l Cai nay... van chua co tin tuc chac chan. Du chua nhin thay thi the nhung toi so...

original: 關羽絕不會死！那不可能，那不可能……
translated: Quan Vu se khong bao gio chet! Dieu do la khong the, dieu do la khong the...

original: 大哥，你也這麼認為吧．
translated: Anh ban, anh cung nghi vay.

original: 大哥，你就說是這麼想的吧……東吳狗賊，竟敢對二哥……
translated: Anh oi, anh cu noi nhu anh nghi di... Dong Ngo, do trom, sao dam doi xu voi anh hai...

original: 張飛……我與你一樣，但是現在需要冷靜．
translated: Truong Phi...Toi cung nhu ban, nhung bay gio can phai binh tinh lai.

original: 東吳狗賊，我要讓你們付出代價！
translated: Dong Ngo, ten trom, ta se bat nguoi phai tra gia!

original: 什麼……關羽……這不是真的……
translated: Cai gi... Quan Vu...khong phai su that dau...

original: l那我先退下去了．
translated: l Vay thi toi se rut lui truoc.

original: 關羽……你怎麼能這樣就……我們不是對天起過誓嗎？你怎麼這麼快就去了？……
translated: Quan Vu...Sao anh co the...chang phai chung toi da the voi Chua sao? Sao anh di nhanh the? …

original: 許昌發生了什麼事，聽聽使者報告吧．
translated: Ho Xu: Chuyen gi xay ra vay? Hay cung nghe bao cao cua nguoi dua tin.

original: 畜生！東吳狗賊！孫權混蛋！大哥，什麼時候出師伐吳？我一定要去！
translated: tan bao! Ten trom cho Dong Ngo! Ton Quyen khon kiep! Anh oi, khi nao chung ta se tan cong Ngo? Toi phai di!

original: 雖然我們丟失了荊州，但現在需要冷靜，不要太激動了．
translated: Du da mat Kinh Chau nhung bay gio chung ta can phai binh tinh va khong nen qua phan khich.

original: 不要著急．發生了什麼事？
translated: Dung lo lang. Chuyen gi da xay ra the?

original: p首先是曹操死了，他的長子曹丕繼位．
translated: p Dau tien Tao Thao chet, con trai ca la Tao Phi ke vi.

original: 什麼？曹操死了？！……還有什麼事？
translated: Cai gi? Tao Thao da chet? ! ...gi nua?

original: p曹丕繼位後，廢掉了獻帝，自己當上皇帝，改國號為“魏”．
translated: p Sau khi Tao Phi len ngoi, ong phe truat Hoang de Tay An va tu minh tro thanh hoang de, doi ten nuoc thanh "Wei".

original: 什麼！那獻帝怎麼樣了？
translated: Cai gi! Con Hoang de Xian thi sao?

original: p……據說被趕出了許昌，放逐到荒郊，寂寞度日．
translated: p... Nghe noi han bi duoi ra khoi Ho Hu, day den noi hoang da, song trong co doc.

original: 豈有此理……難道我畢生的奮鬥目標重振漢室就這樣毀於曹丕之手嗎？只因我力量不夠啊……
translated: That la vo ly... Chang le muc dich ca doi cua toi la phuc hung nha Han da bi Tao Phi pha huy? Chi vi toi khong du suc...

original: p那我先退了．
translated: p Vay thi toi se rut lui truoc.

original: 我，還有關羽終生追求的重振漢室的理想難道實現不了了嗎？怎麼會這樣？
translated: Co phai toi va Quan Vu suot doi theo duoi ly tuong hoi sinh nha Han? sao vay?

original: 誰？好吧，叫他進來．
translated: Ai? Duoc roi, de anh ta vao.

original: 是東吳的使者？偷襲了關羽，現在還到這裡來幹什麼？大哥，殺了他吧．
translated: Nguoi dua tin tu Dong Ngo? Sau khi danh len Quan Vu, bay gio ban dang lam gi o day? Anh trai, giet han di.

original: ……不能這樣．先問問他想說什麼，再殺他也不遲．
translated: ...khong the nhu the nay duoc. Truoc tien hay hoi anh ta nhung gi anh ta muon noi, sau do giet anh ta.

original: 媽的！還敢厚著臉皮來啊！
translated: Oi chet tiet! Sao nguoi dam den day mot cach vo liem si nhu vay!

original: 諸葛瑾作為吳國特使前來求見．
translated: Gia Cat Tan den gap ong voi tu cach la dac phai vien cua nuoc Ngo.

original: 嗤！吳國狗賊，派我們軍師的哥哥來當使者，太卑鄙了．這樣我可不好下手了．
translated: cuoi! nuoc Ngo Huu dao tac, sai anh em co van quan su cua chung ta di su that la hen ha. Se rat kho de toi bat dau.

original: ……先聽聽我哥哥說什麼吧．
translated: …Hay nghe nhung gi anh trai toi noi truoc da.

original: 主公，我很了解你的心情，可是請看在我的面子上不要殺了我哥哥．
translated: Chua oi, toi rat hieu tam trang cua ban, nhung xin dung giet anh trai toi vi toi.

original:
畜生，孫權狗賊！派使者來幹什麼？
如果不是軍師的哥哥，我早就把他殺了．
translated:
Quai vat, ten trom cho Ton Quyen! Tai sao phai cu su gia?
Neu khong co anh trai co van quan su, toi da giet han tu lau roi.

original: 主公，現在請控制情緒，不要感情用事．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay kiem soat cam xuc cua minh ngay bay gio va dung xuc dong.

original: 諸葛瑾，你來有何貴幹？
translated: Gia Cat Tan, sao nguoi lai o day?

original: 曹丕稱帝的消息想必皇叔已經知道了．這種事我們也難以容忍．我此次來，就是想與魏廢除盟約，而與蜀國結盟．如果締結了盟約，我們打算奉還荊州．請您能給我一個滿意的答覆．
translated: Chu cua hoang de chac chan da biet tin Tao Phi xung de. Chung toi khong the chiu dung duoc loai chuyen nay. Lan nay ta toi day de huy bo lien minh voi Nguy va thanh lap lien minh voi nuoc Thuc. Neu hiep uoc duoc ky ket, chung toi co y dinh tra lai Kinh Chau. Xin hay cho toi mot cau tra loi thoa dang.

original: 我認為不應與吳作戰．如果我們與吳國交戰，得利的是魏國．現在應忘記荊州和關羽，與吳結盟．
translated: Toi khong nghi chung ta nen chien dau voi Wu. Neu chung ta danh voi Nuoc Ngo thi nguoi chien thang la Nuoc Nguoi. Bay gio Kinh Chau, Quan Vu nen bi lang quen va phai lien minh voi Ngo.

original: 不要聽他胡說．二哥如此慘遭殺害，這豈能忘掉．大哥，決不能結盟．
translated: Dung nghe nhung loi vo nghia cua anh ay. Nguoi anh thu hai bi giet mot cach da man nhu vay, lam sao chung ta co the quen duoc dieu nay? Anh em, chung ta khong duoc thanh lap mot lien minh.

original: 我覺得應該與吳結盟．伐吳是主公的私事，不會得到天下人的響應．
translated: Toi nghi chung ta nen thanh lap lien minh voi Wu. Danh bai Ngo la chuyen rieng cua chua te va se khong nhan duoc phan hoi tu nguoi dan thien ha.

original: 您作出決定了嗎？
translated: Ban da dua ra quyet dinh chua?

original: 那就請您答覆．
translated: Sau do xin vui long tra loi.

original: 噢，謝謝．我馬上去向吳侯報喜訊．這是吳國的一點心意，請您笑納．
translated: O, cam on ban. Toi se di bao tin vui ngay cho Ngo Hau. Day la mot chut suy nghi cua Nuoc Ngo, mong cac ban tiep thu.

original: 那我馬上回去報告我家主公．
translated: Sau do toi se quay lai va bao cao voi chua te cua toi ngay lap tuc.

original: 主公，您作出了正確的決斷．但您內心一定很痛苦吧．
translated: Thua ngai, ngai da quyet dinh dung dan. Nhung chac trong long ban dang dau lam.

original: ……吳國確實可恨，但現在不能與吳爭鬥．應先討伐曹丕，重興漢室．張飛，請你諒解我．
translated: ... nuoc Ngo qua thuc rat dang ghet, nhung hien tai khong the cung Ngo danh nhau. Tao Phi can phai chinh phuc truoc va nha Han can duoc hoi sinh. Truong Phi, xin hay tha thu cho toi.

original: ……以前我信任大哥，……今後也會．
translated: ...Toi da tin tuong anh trai minh trong qua khu va toi cung se lam nhu vay trong tuong lai.

original: 張飛，謝謝．
translated: Truong Phi Cam on ban.

original: 你回去對孫權說，我忘不了奪去荊州和殺害關羽的仇恨．想結盟，做夢！
translated: Nguoi ve noi voi Ton Quyen, ta se khong bao gio quen han thu cuop Kinh Chau, giet Quan Vu. Neu ban muon thanh lap mot lien minh, hay mo uoc!

original: 這……，劉備大人，請您三思……
translated: Viec nay... ong Luu Bi xin ong hay suy nghi ky lai...

original: 是的．現在與吳作戰，只會讓曹丕高興．請……
translated: Dung. Danh Ngo bay gio chi lam Tao Phi vui ve ma thoi. Xin vui long……

original: 住口，孔明！你能體會到手足被害的心情嗎？
translated: Im di, Khong Minh! Ban co hieu duoc cam giac cua mot nguoi anh em bi giet khong?

original: 你馬上回去傳話吧，蜀選擇戰爭．如果你不是諸葛軍師的哥哥，我不會讓你活著回去．
translated: Ban quay lai ngay de nhan tin, Shu chon chien tranh. Neu anh khong phai la anh trai cua Gia Cat, toi se khong de anh song sot tro ve.

original: 到底是我的大哥！我馬上就去準備．
translated: Du sao thi anh ay cung la anh trai lon cua toi! Toi se chuan bi ngay.

original: 張飛，不要太著急．
translated: Truong Phi, dung qua lo lang.

original: 已經等了這麼長時間，不能再慢吞吞了．大哥也快點準備吧．
translated: Toi da cho doi rat lau roi va khong the doi duoc nua. Anh em hay nhanh tay chuan bi nhe.

original: 大哥，下令出征吧．
translated: Anh em hay ra lenh ra tran.

original: 孔明，對不起．剛才我過分了．
translated: Khong Minh, toi xin loi. Vua nay toi da di qua xa roi.

original: 沒有關係．我也有錯．
translated: No khong quan trong. Toi cung da sai.

original: 孔明，應該怎樣伐吳？
translated: Khong Minh, lam sao danh bai Ngo?

original: 先攻下西陵城，再以那裡為據點，然後再進軍．
translated: Dau tien chiem thanh Tay Lang, sau do dung no lam thanh tri, sau do tien quan ve phia truoc.

original: 嗯，孔明，你留下抵禦曹丕，趙雲、馬超輔佐你．
translated: Thoi Khong Minh, nguoi o lai chong lai Tao Phi, Trieu Van va Ma Sieu se ho tro nguoi.

original: 西陵在去江陵的路上，快出發吧．
translated: Tay Lang dang tren duong den Giang Lang, chung ta di nhanh thoi.

original: 要為關羽報仇……嗯，那不是吳班嗎？
translated: De tra thu cho Quan Vu... a, do khong phai la Wu Ban sao?

original: 怎麼啦？神色慌張，出什麼事了？
translated: Co chuyen gi vay? Anh ta trong co ve hoang so, chuyen gi da xay ra vay?

original: 稟報主公，……張飛被部下范疆、張達殺害了．
translated: Bao chua... Truong Phi bi thuoc ha Pham Giang va Truong Dat giet chet.

original: 什麼！這次出師，最高興的就是張飛．那抓到范疆、張達了嗎？
translated: Cai gi! Nguoi vui mung nhat trong dot tap huan nay chinh la Truong Phi. Fan Jiang va Zhang Da da bi bat chua?

original: 他們都逃到東吳去了．
translated: Tat ca deu tron sang Dong Ngo.

original: 關羽、張飛，你們都離我而去了．可是……，關羽、張飛，我不會失敗，一定會為你們報仇．
translated: Quan Vu, Truong Phi, anh bo em het roi. Nhung... Quan Vu, Truong Phi, ta se khong that bai, nhat dinh se bao thu cho cac nguoi.

original: 要為關羽報仇．噢，張飛來了啊．
translated: De tra thu cho Quan Vu. O, Truong Phi day roi.

original: 大哥，對不起，我來晚了．我回去做了些準備，時間就過了．
translated: Anh trai, toi xin loi, toi den muon. Toi quay lai va chuan bi mot so thu, va thoi gian troi qua.

original: 好，現在人到齊了．進軍西陵！
translated: Duoc roi, bay gio moi nguoi deu o day. Tien vao Tay Lang!

original: 主公，請編隊．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay lap doi hinh.

original: 向西陵進軍．
translated: Tien ve phia Tay Lang.

original:
此時，已經擔任東吳都督的陸遜正在江陵向武將們講解自己的策略．
　東吳歷任都督是周瑜、魯肅、呂蒙，現在是陸遜．陸遜以前從未指揮過戰役，這次任命是破格提拔．
translated:
Luc nay, Luc Ton, nguoi tung lam tong tran Dong Ngo, dang giai thich chien luoc cua minh cho cac tuong linh o Giang Lang.
Cac thong doc ke tiep cua Dong Ngo la Chu Du, Lo Tuc, Lu Mong va bay gio la Luc Ton. Luc Ton chua tung chi huy mot chien dich nao truoc day nen viec bo nhiem nay la mot su thang tien dac biet.

original: 使關羽失去荊州的主要原因不是呂蒙，而是陸遜．陸遜向呂蒙講授了如何使關羽疏忽大意，並趁機奪取荊州的計謀．呂蒙對陸遜的睿智深為驚異，並舉薦他為自己的後任．
translated: Nguyen nhan chinh khien Quan Vu mat Kinh Chau khong phai la Lu Mong ma la Luc Ton. Luc Ton day Lu Mong cach lam Quan Vu bat can, chop thoi co chiem lay muu ke cua Kinh Chau. Lu Mong vo cung ngac nhien truoc su thong thai cua Luc Ton va tien cu ong lam nguoi ke vi.

original: 嗯，都督，您不打算增援西陵了？
translated: Ach, Thong doc, ngai khong co y dinh tiep vien Tay Lang sao?

original: 西陵並不重要，我想那裡的守將孫桓應該知道這一點．放棄西陵並不是失敗．
translated: Tay Lang khong quan trong. Toi nghi Ton Huan, nguoi bao ve o do, nen biet dieu nay. Tu bo Tay Lang khong phai la that bai.

original: 什麼！我不同意！
translated: Cai gi! Toi khong dong y!

original: 我是吳侯親自任命的都督，你要聽我的命令，決不能出征．
translated: Toi la tong tu lenh do chinh Ngo Hau bo nhiem. Ban phai tuan theo menh lenh cua toi va khong bao gio tham chien.

original: 媽的……怕死的膽小鬼……
translated: Me kiep...ke hen nhat so chet...

original: 你說什麼？
translated: Ban da noi gi?

original: 沒有，我什麼也沒說．
translated: Khong, toi khong noi gi ca.

original: 是嗎？那樣最好．諸位將軍也要服從我的命令，我的話完了．
translated: Vang? Dieu do tot nhat. Tat ca cac tuong linh cung phai tuan theo menh lenh cua toi. Loi cua toi da noi xong.

original: 眾將官，要為關羽報仇，向孫權軍雪恨！
translated: Hoi cac tuong quan, chung ta phai bao thu cho Quan Vu va bao thu cho quan Ton Quyen!

original: 哎呀呀……大家一定要守住，等待援軍的到來．
translated: Rat tiec... Moi nguoi phai co thu va cho quan tiep vien den.

original:
主公，我來遲了，對不起．我是關羽的兒子關興．
我此次來是為了報父仇，請讓我加入戰鬥．
translated:
Chua oi, toi den muon, toi xin loi. Toi la Quan Hung, con trai cua Quan Vu.
Toi den day de tra thu cho cha toi. Xin hay cho toi tham gia tran chien.

original: 我豈能落在關興後面？主公，我是張飛之子張苞，此次作戰我也要參加．
translated: Lam sao toi co the tut lai phia sau Quan Hung? Thua ngai, toi la Truong Bao, con trai Truong Phi, toi cung muon tham gia tran chien nay.

original: 父親，請帶我去．不過，刀箭很可怕呀．
translated: Cha oi, xin hay dua con den do. Tuy nhien, kiem va mui ten rat khung khiep.

original: 敵將何在！我是張飛之子張苞！
translated: Ke thu o dau? Toi la Truong Bao, con trai Truong Phi!

original: 喔，你就是張飛的兒子．我來教訓你！
translated: O, cau la con trai Truong Phi. Hay de toi day cho ban mot bai hoc!

original: 殺死了敵將！
translated: Giet tuong dich!

original: 我是關羽的兒子關興，誰敢與我單挑！
translated: Ta la Quan Hung con trai Quan Vu, ai dam khieu chien ta?

original: 黃毛小兒，休得猖狂！我來了！
translated: Cau be toc vang, dung kieu ngao nua! Toi dang den!

original: 你就是關興？還在想爸爸吧．
translated: Ban la Quan Hung phai khong? Van nghi ve bo.

original: 住口！你給我過來！
translated: cam mieng! Hay den day!

original: 過去又怎樣．
translated: Vay truoc day thi sao?

original: 一刀結果你……
translated: Mot con dao se giet chet ban...

original: 這種對手也敢口出狂言？
translated: Doi thu nhu vay dam noi lung tung?

original: 混蛋！……撤退！
translated: thang khon! ……rut lui!

original: 繳獲黃金１４００！
translated: 1.400 vang bi tich thu!

original: 那麼進西陵城吧．
translated: Sau do tien vao thanh Tay Lang.

original: p孫桓軍被劉備擊敗，正往這裡退卻．
translated: p Ton Hoan Quan bi Luu Bi danh bai va dang rut lui ve day.

original: 孫桓怎麼樣？
translated: Con Ton Huan thi sao?

original: p他沒什麼事．
translated: p Khong co gi sai voi anh ta.

original: 是嗎？那太好了．你辛苦了．
translated: Vang? Dieu do that tuyet. Cam on ban da lam viec cham chi.

original: p我退下去了．
translated: p Toi rut lui.

original: 有什麼好的，是我們吃敗仗啊！
translated: Dieu tot la chung ta da bi danh bai!

original: 這次失敗在我預料之中．第一，劉備軍進攻士氣正旺，勢不可擋．硬要抗拒他們，我軍會有很大傷亡．
translated: That bai nay da duoc mong doi. Dau tien, tinh than tan cong cua Luu Bi rat cao va khong the ngan can. Neu chung ta nhat quyet chong lai chung, quan ta se bi thuong vong nang ne.

original: 與其與他們正面對抗，不如靜觀其動向，他們不久就會疲憊的．那時我們再進攻，必能打敗他們．
translated: Thay vi doi dau truc tiep voi ho, tot hon la nen cho xem hanh dong cua ho, ho se som met moi. Neu chung ta tan cong lan nua, chung ta chac chan se danh bai chung.

original: 那會是什麼時候？
translated: Khi nao thi do?

original: 不知道．可能兩年，也可能三年．
translated: khong co y tuong Co the la hai nam, co the la ba nam.

original: 都督閣下！
translated: Thua Thong doc!

original: 哈哈哈．我開玩笑．不久劉備軍就會等得不耐煩，而前來進攻江陵，那時候就是我們進攻的時候．
translated: Hahaha. Toi dang dua day. Chang bao lau nua quan Luu Bi se mat kien nhan va tien den tan cong Giang Lang. Do la luc chung toi tan cong.

original: 主公，諸葛瑾來求見．
translated: Thua ngai, Gia Cat Tan da den gap ngai.

original: 他又來了．讓他進來．
translated: Anh ay lai o day nua. Hay de anh ay vao.

original: 劉備大人，我諸葛瑾又來了．
translated: Su phu Luu Bi, toi, Gia Cat Tan, lai den day.

original: 父親，這個地方不舒服．
translated: Cha, noi nay khong thoai mai.

original: 大哥，答覆其實早有了．
translated: Thua anh, cau tra loi thuc su da co roi.

original: 關興的父親被東吳殺了，不能就此罷休．
translated: Cha cua Quan Hung bi Dong Ngo giet chet, ong khong the tha thu duoc.

original: 父親是死於東吳之手，決不能放過他們．
translated: Cha ong da chet duoi tay Dong Ngo, ong khong duoc de ho ra di.

original: 殺父之仇，不共戴天．主公，請允許我殺了這個傢伙．
translated: Noi han thu giet cha toi la khong the dung hoa duoc. Lay Chua, xin hay cho phep con giet ten nay.

original: 不可，他畢竟是孔明的哥哥，你要忍忍．
translated: Khong, han du sao cung la anh trai Khong Minh, nguoi phai kien nhan.

original: 最近年輕人生龍活虎，屢立戰功，難道我老了，不中用了……
translated: Thoi gian gan day, gioi tre rat nang dong va lap duoc nhieu chien tich quan su. Phai chang toi dang gia di va vo dung...

original: 主公，請與諸葛瑾交談．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay noi chuyen voi Gia Cat Tan.

original: 又是為結盟而來的吧．
translated: Co le ho den day de thanh lap mot lien minh.

original: 是的，我家主公願意把謀害張飛的兇手交還給蜀國，並且願意歸還荊州．希望與蜀國結盟修好，今後不斷加深兩國的友誼，劉備大人，你意下如何？
translated: Dung vay, chua te bang long tra ke sat hai Truong Phi cho nuoc Thuc, bang long tra lai Kinh Chau. Toi hy vong co the hinh thanh lien minh, han gan voi nuoc Thuc va tiep tuc lam sau sac them tinh huu nghi giua hai nuoc trong tuong lai. Thay nghi sao, Thay Luu Bi?

original: 我家主公非常後悔與魏國結盟，所以想與魏國絕交，改與蜀國結盟修好，今後不斷加深兩國的友誼，劉備大人，你意下如何？
translated: Lanh chua rat hoi han khi lien minh voi Nuoc Nguoi nen muon cat dut quan he voi Nuoc Nguoi, thay vao do lien minh voi Nuoc Thuc de cau hoa. Trong thoi gian toi, chung ta se tiep tuc lam sau sac them tinh huu nghi giua hai nuoc. Ong Luu Bi, ong nghi the nao?

original: 主公，我們大敗孫桓率領的孫權軍，應該說，在某種程度上已經雪恨了，如果再處死那些叛逆，就再也沒有仇恨了．所以，我覺得應該與吳結盟．
translated: Thua ngai, chung ta da danh bai quan Ton Quyen do Ton Huan chi huy. Can phai noi rang chung toi da tra thu duoc o mot muc do nhat dinh. Neu chung ta xu tu bon phan loan do mot lan nua thi se khong con han thu nua. Vi vay, toi nghi chung ta nen thanh lap lien minh voi Ngo.

original: 劉備大人，您決定了嗎？
translated: Luu Bi ngai da quyet dinh chua?

original: 劉備大人，您將做何答覆？
translated: Thua ngai Luu Bi, ngai se tra loi the nao?

original: ……吳國確實可恨，但現在沒時間為關羽悲傷．現在應該討伐曹丕，重興漢室．
translated: ... nuoc Ngo qua that rat dang ghet, nhung bay gio khong con thoi gian de dau buon cho Quan Vu nua. Bay gio chung ta nen danh bai Tao Phi va hoi sinh nha Han.

original: 諸葛瑾，我的答覆沒有變，你還是回去吧．
translated: Gia Cat Tan, dap an cua ta van khong thay doi, nguoi nen quay ve di.

original: 劉備大人，請您慎重考慮一下．
translated: Xin ngai Luu Bi hay can nhac ky viec nay.

original: 這不能說服我，你回去吧．
translated: Dieu nay khong thuyet phuc duoc toi, ban quay lai.

original: 主公，現在應該與他們修好．
translated: Lay Chua, chung ta nen lam hoa voi ho ngay bay gio.

original: 不要再說了，我意已決．
translated: Dung noi nua, toi da quyet dinh roi.

original: ……我知道了．那就考慮進攻吧．聽說吳國都督是陸遜．
translated: ……Toi hieu roi. Sau do hay can nhac viec tan cong. Nghe noi thong doc nuoc Ngo la Luc Ton.

original: 陸遜？沒聽說過呀．
translated: Luc Ton? Chua bao gio nghe noi ve no.

original: 雖然他名聲不大，但我聽說此人深有謀略，主公不可小看他．
translated: Tuy rang han khong noi danh, nhung nghe noi nguoi nay muu luoc sau xa, chu nhan khong the coi thuong han.

original: 敵人在江陵，快跟上！
translated: Dich dang o Giang Lang, mau duoi theo!

original: 什麼！劉備出動了．我等候他多時了．現在正是擊潰劉備的最好時機，全軍，進軍彝陵！
translated: Cai gi! Luu Bi dang di chuyen. Toi da doi anh ay rat lau roi. Bay gio la thoi co tot nhat de danh bai Luu Bi, toan quan tien ve Yiling!

original: 呵呵呵．孔明不在這裡真乃天助我也，只有他才能識破我的戰略．劉備真是個糊塗蟲，竟敢率軍冒然突進．看來劉備的氣數已盡．
translated: Hahaha. Chua dang giup toi neu Khong Minh khong co o day. Chi co anh ay moi co the nhin thau chien luoc cua toi. Luu Bi ngu ngoc den muc dam dan quan tan cong bat ngo. Duong nhu suc luc cua Luu Bi da can kiet.

original: 都督，起風了．
translated: Chi huy, gio dang thoi.

original: 好啊．這裡是通風之處，而且地勢狹窄，我就在這裡等候劉備．
translated: DUOC ROI. Day la noi thong thoang, dia hinh hep. Toi se doi Luu Bi o day.

original: 都督所言極是．……都督，你有如此妙計，我卻對您無禮，實在對不起．
translated: Nhung gi Thong doc noi la hoan toan dung. ...Thuyen truong, anh co mot ke hoach that thong minh, nhung toi lai tho lo voi anh. Toi thuc su xin loi.

original: 行了，等打完這一仗再說這事也不遲．好，放火！燒盡劉備軍！
translated: Duoc roi, van chua qua muon de noi ve dieu nay sau khi tran chien nay ket thuc. Duoc roi, dot lua di! Dot chay quan Luu Bi!

original: 主，主公．大事不好！敵人用火攻了．
translated: Lay Chua, Chua oi. Co dieu gi do toi te da xay ra! Ke thu tan cong bang lua.

original: 唉……現在我軍眾多倒成為累贅了．前方道路越來越窄了．
translated: Than oi... Gio day doi quan dong dao cua chung ta da tro thanh ganh nang. Con duong phia truoc cang ngay cang hep.

original: 取勝的時機到了！不要放走了劉備！吳國的命運在此一戰！
translated: Da den luc chien thang! Dung de Luu Bi di! So phan cua nuoc Ngo dang bi de doa o day!

original: 怎麼？這支部隊是？主將是誰？
translated: Lam sao? Doi quan nay la gi? Tuong quan la ai?

original: 我就是主將．
translated: Toi la tuong quan.

original: 嚇，是蠻族啊，一看你就知道是蠻族，我還是第一次見到蠻族．好，與我單挑吧．
translated: So hai, do la mot ke man ro. Ban co the biet do la mot ke man ro chi bang cach nhin vao no. Day la lan dau tien toi nhin thay mot ke man ro. Duoc roi, thach dau tay doi voi toi.

original: 好，來吧！
translated: Duoc roi, di nao!

original: 招！怎麼只有招架之功．
translated: lua! Tai sao chi co the do don?

original: 唉呀……太累了……
translated: oi...met qua...

original: 你怎麼了，動作這麼慢？
translated: Cau bi sao vay, di chuyen cham the?

original: 嘿！這幾下怎麼樣？
translated: Chao! The con nhung luc nay thi sao?

original: 哈哈……
translated: Ha ha……

original: 你好像累了，我送你去歇歇．
translated: Em co ve met roi, anh dua em di nghi nhe.

original: 我命休矣……
translated: Cuoc doi toi sap ket thuc roi...

original: 哈哈哈．機不可失！全軍總攻！劉備，這次你休想逃脫．
translated: Hahaha. Dung bo lo co hoi nay! Toan quan tan cong! Luu Bi, lan nay nguoi khong the tron thoat duoc roi.

original: 真倒霉！好不容易有此良機……全軍撤退！
translated: That la xui xeo! Cuoi cung cung co duoc co hoi nay...toan quan rut lui!

original: 繳獲了黃金１４００！
translated: 1.400 vang bi tich thu!

original: 唉，難道我要死在這裡嗎……
translated: Than oi, toi se chet o day sao...

original: 主公，不要氣餒！我們撤到白帝城吧．
translated: Lay Chua, dung nan long! Hay rut lui ve Bach De Thanh.

original: 我們來殿後．主公，快撤！
translated: Chung ta hay den phia sau cung dien. Chua oi, hay rut lui nhanh chong!

original: 喔，關興，張苞．好吧，撤退回白帝城．
translated: Oi Quan Hung, Truong Bao. Thoi rut lui ve Bach De Thanh.

original: 劉備怎麼了？看見他了嗎？什麼！被他跑掉了……算了，劉備再也沒有實力了，現在我最擔心的是魏國．好，全軍馬上去防備魏軍．
translated: Lu Bi co chuyen gi vay? Ban co nhin thay anh ay khong? Cai gi! Anh bo chay... Quen di, Luu Bi khong con suc luc nua. Dieu toi lo lang nhat bay gio chinh la Nuoc Nguoi. Duoc roi, toan quan se len phong thu quan Nguy ngay.

original: 大哥，你沒事吧．
translated: Anh trai, anh on chu?

original: 是你呀，張飛．對不起……我沒能給關羽報仇．
translated: La em day Truong Phi. Toi xin loi...toi khong the tra thu cho Quan Vu.

original: 大哥，不要害怕！關羽還活著！
translated: Anh em dung so! Quan Vu con song!
Than oi... than oi... oi!

original: 啊，大哥，振作些！
translated: Ah, anh trai, hay vui len!

original: 關羽，張飛，對不起．沒能殺死你們的仇人，請原諒你們的大哥……
translated: Quan Vu, Truong Phi, xin loi. Xin hay tha thu cho anh trai cua ban vi da khong the giet duoc ke thu cua ban...

original: 張飛，對不起．關羽的仇沒能報……
translated: Truong Phi, toi xin loi. Su tra thu cua Quan Vu khong duoc bao thu...

original: 說什麼呀！大哥，求求你！不要讓我一個人留下．
translated: Ban dang noi ve cai gi vay! Anh oi, lam on! Dung bo toi mot minh.

original: 哈哈哈……到什麼時候你都還是急脾氣……張飛，我的天壽也到盡頭了．
translated: Hahaha... Du the nao di nua anh van nong nay... Truong Phi, cuoc doi em sap ket thuc roi.

original: 大哥，振作些！
translated: Anh em hay vui len!

original:
孔明，多虧了你，我才能奪得漢中，才有今天這樣的局面．
這次，我沒聽你的勸告而去討伐東吳，以致遭到如此慘敗，這是報應啊．
translated:
Khong Minh, nho co nguoi ma ta moi bat duoc Han Trung va co duoc tinh the nhu ngay hom nay.
Lan nay ta khong nghe loi khuyen cua nguoi ma tien danh Dong Ngo, dan den that bai tham hai nhu vay. Day la qua bao.

original: 主公，不要再想這些了．我心裡連一次都沒報怨過你．
translated: Chua oi, dung nghi ve dieu nay nua. Trong long toi chua bao gio phan nan voi ban du chi mot lan.

original: 唉．……孔明，我有一事相求．
translated: Tot. ...Kong Ming, toi co chuyen muon hoi cau.

original: 什麼事啊？
translated: Chuyen gi dang xay ra vay?

original: 老天已經在召喚我啦．我是想讓劉禪繼位．可是劉禪不成器，必要的時候請你取而代之．孔明，只有你才能消滅曹丕．
translated: Chua dang goi toi roi. Toi muon Luu Thien thanh cong. Nhung Luu Thien vo dung, hay thay the anh ta neu can thiet. Kong Ming, chi co ban moi co the tieu diet Tao Phi.

original: 主公，不要那麼想，我孔明誓死效忠蜀國．嗚嗚……
translated: Dai nhan, dung nghi nhu vay, ta Khong Minh the trung thanh cho den chet. Woohoo...

original: 謝謝．……趙雲，我們同甘共苦到今天，我在這裡與你告別很傷感啊．
translated: Cam on. ... Trieu Van, chung ta da chia se niem vui noi buon cho den ngay hom nay. Toi rat buon khi phai noi loi tam biet voi cac ban o day.

original: 主，主公……
translated: Chua oi, Chua oi...

original: 希望大家盡力輔佐劉禪．
translated: Mong moi nguoi se co gang het suc de ho tro Luu Thien.

original: 主公！主公……！
translated: Chua oi! Chua oi...!

original: 大哥！為什麼把我扔在一邊都不理我！
translated: Anh trai! Tai sao ban lai nem toi sang mot ben va phot lo toi?

original: ……對不起，讓我一個人靜一靜，我有些累了……
translated: ...Toi xin loi, de toi yen mot luc, toi hoi met...

original: ……是，臣告退……
translated: ...Vang, toi xin tu chuc...
Oi…. …………Um? Do la ai?

original: 兄長，我來接你了．
translated: Anh oi, em den don anh day.

original: 噢，關羽！你還活著啊！
translated: Oi Quan Vu! Ban van con song!

original: 不，我已經死了．張飛也……
translated: Khong, toi da chet roi. Truong Phi cung…

original: 大哥，我和關羽已先來到這裡．大哥也累了吧．怎麼樣？來不來這裡？
translated: Anh Quan Vu va em da toi day truoc roi. Dai ca chac cung met lam. The con no thi sao? Ban co den day khong?

original: 是啊……．好吧……．
translated: Dung……. Duoc roi…….

original: 噢，怎麼回事！怎麼會是……關羽？還有張飛！
translated: Oi, chuyen gi dang xay ra vay! Lam sao co the la... Quan Vu? Va Truong Phi!

original: 兄長，走吧……
translated: Anh em oi di thoi...

original: 等一等！關羽求求你，先別把主公從這個世界上帶走！
translated: Doi mot chut! Quan Vu Xin dung mang chua di khoi the gioi nay nua!

original: 大哥，我們在等著你呢……．
translated: Anh em oi, chung toi dang doi anh...

original: 主公！！
translated: Chua oi! !

original: 主公！你要好好考慮！
translated: Chua oi! Ban phai suy nghi can than!

original: 關羽、張飛，現在走吧……．
translated: Quan Vu, Truong Phi, di thoi….
...! Chua oi! ! Chua oi...! !

original: 什麼，曹丕打過來了？不好！我們還沒消滅蜀國．看來這次也得派使者與蜀國結盟了．快返回吳！
translated: Cai gi, Tao Phi goi? khong tot! Chung ta van chua loai bo duoc nuoc Thuc. Xem ra lan nay chung ta phai cu su gia di lien minh voi nuoc Thuc. Hay ve voi Wu nhanh len!

original: 很危險啊．陸遜這個人不可小看啊．
translated: No rat nguy hiem. Luc Ton khong nen xem thuong.

original: 主公，陸遜也撤走了，我們回成都吧．然後再按丞相的意思與吳國結盟如何？
translated: Chua oi, Luc Ton cung da di tan roi, chung ta hay ve Thanh Do thoi. The con viec thanh lap lien minh voi Nuoc Ngo theo y muon cua Thu tuong thi sao?

original: 由於我這一怒之下犯了大錯，以致失去了那麼多愛將．……與吳結盟吧．
translated: Vi nong gian da pham sai lam lon nen da mat di bao nhieu tuong yeu quy. ...Hay thanh lap lien minh voi Wu.
